name: bank-core

scripts.prisma:copyenv: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env.local')) fs.writeFileSync('.env', fs.readFileSync('.env.local')); else console.error('.env.local not found');"
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run prisma:copyenv && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:push: npm run prisma:copyenv && npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:copyenv && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:studio: npm run prisma:copyenv && npx prisma studio
